title: S.A.M Custom Playable Race
description: A mod-defined playable race that rides an existing monster body. Registered into a reserved race id (200-255); appears in the character-select race picker, renders as its host body in both third- and first-person, and applies flat attribute/HP/MP bonuses at character creation. A vanilla or mod-less client that loads such a character plays it as Human (graceful degrade).

name.description: Display name shown in the character-select race picker, e.g. "Frostborn".

host_body.description: The existing monster body this race renders as. Only these 18 bodies have a proper first-person arm, so both views are correct.

description.description: Short flavour text for the race (shown in the picker's info panel).

stat_modifiers.description: Flat attribute / HP / MP bonuses added at character creation (may be negative). Vanilla races give no attribute bonuses, so these are the race's whole stat identity.

blood_diet.description: If true, this race sustains on blood instead of food (like a vampire).

starting_spells.description: Innate spells this race knows from creation. Vanilla "SPELL_X" names or your own "namespace:spell".

allies.description: Monster types that will not attack this race, and that this race will not attack, on top of whatever the host body already gets along with. A goatman-bodied race is already left alone by goatmen; this is for relations the host body does NOT have, e.g. ["gnome", "troll"]. Leave it out to inherit the host body's relations unchanged.

enemies.description: Monster types that are always hostile to this race, even ones the host body gets along with. Listing a type in both allies and enemies makes it an enemy, and the game log says so.

limb_models.description: This race's own body, one model per limb, instead of the host body's. host_body still decides the skeleton: the limb offsets, the animation, and which slots exist. These decide what is drawn in each slot. Omit a limb and it keeps the host body's model, so you can replace just a head or the whole body. Every limb except the head is only visible when that armour slot is empty, which is how every race in the game already works.

head.description: The head. This is the one limb no armour ever replaces, so it always shows. Three forms are accepted: an id you declared in mod.json "models" ("<ns>:name"), a mod-relative path to your own .vox ("models/<ns>/foo.vox"), or a raw vanilla model index (1..nummodels-1; remember models.txt line N is index N-1).

torso.description: The chest. Shown bare; a breastplate covers it, exactly as it does for any other race. Three forms are accepted: an id you declared in mod.json "models" ("<ns>:name"), a mod-relative path to your own .vox ("models/<ns>/foo.vox"), or a raw vanilla model index (1..nummodels-1; remember models.txt line N is index N-1).
